items.note: Page confirms coalition says 'we gaan in gesprek over het sluiten van de Bijenkorfgarage' and housing there; Bijenkorf owns it, Q-Park operates under lease; Bijenkorf said it was not aware and heard via media, Q-Park said it learned of it from the coalition agreement. The page does not say the proposal is for talks 'with De Bijenkorf' specifically, and 'neither party was consulted' is a paraphrase of both saying they learned of it from the agreement/media. Real title differs from draft title (fixed). Published 4 Jun 2026.
items.corrected_text: The June 2026 coalition agreement says the city will enter talks about closing the Bijenkorf garage at Damrak and building housing on the site. The garage is owned by De Bijenkorf and operated by Q-Park under a lease; both said they learned of the idea through the coalition agreement or the media.
items.corrected_title: Bijenkorf 'staat open voor dialoog' over idee voor sluiting Bijenkorfgarage en woningbouw

items.note: Page (10-06-2026, O&S figures) confirms 23.7 million tourist overnight stays in 2025 and day visits 21.9 million in 2025 vs 24.1 million in 2019. The claim that this is 'about 800,000 more than in 2024' is not on the page. Attribution to the city's research and statistics office (O&S) is confirmed. Title matches.
items.corrected_text: Amsterdam recorded 23.7 million tourist overnight stays in 2025. Day visits were 21.9 million in 2025 against 24.1 million in 2019, according to figures from the city's research and statistics office as published by the hotel and catering association KHN.

corrected_summary: Amsterdam raised its on-street tariff in the old centre to EUR 7.50 an hour in April 2019 and in 2018 set out a plan to remove 7,000 to 10,000 street parking spaces over seven years. Municipal garage tariffs were aligned with street prices from February 2024, and park-and-ride capacity has been reduced, including the closure of P+R Zeeburg 1 in January 2025. The June 2026 coalition agreement says parking permits will become more expensive and proposes talks about closing the Bijenkorf garage at Damrak.
